aiConsent.title: AI features & your data
aiConsent.subtitle: Please review before continuing
aiConsent.intro: MIA uses third-party AI services to power the voice assistant, receipt scanning, calendar imports and smart suggestions. We need your permission before sending any of your content to those services.

whatWeSend.title: What we send
whatWeSend.voice: The voice audio you record when you tap the microphone
whatWeSend.photos: Photos of receipts, calendars, or notes you upload
whatWeSend.text: Text prompts, grocery items, tasks and events you type

whoReceives.title: Who receives it
whoReceives.google: (Gemini AI models, routed through the Lovable AI Gateway) — text, images, categorization

aiConsent.processingNote: These providers process your data only to return an AI response to MIA and are contractually required to protect it. We never sell your data.
aiConsent.contentModeration: Objectionable, illegal, or abusive content is filtered and not tolerated.
aiConsent.reportAbusePrefix: Report abuse or block users via
aiConsent.declineNote: . If you decline, MIA will sign you out because its features rely on these AI services.
